ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) background estimated at ~75% coverage with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters making up the remaining ~25% localized at the base and margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters forming a complex, contiguous mottled pattern along the lower 30% of both lobe margins. The upper and central regions consist of a low-intensity dark matrix interrupted by discrete vertical white linear segments and small punctate clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a narrow angular convergence and significant bounding-box depth relative to the fluke baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged serrations along the left lobe trailing edge. The right lobe trailing edge features a deep, irregular macro-indentation (semi-circular excision) near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curvature of the trailing edges, with the right lobe's trajectory being significantly disrupted by a large concave geometric anomaly.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, roughly circular high-intensity white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the dark central and upper regions of both lobes, ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive series of parallel and intersecting high-contrast white linear features (rake marks) oriented vertically from the trailing edge towards the base, most prominent on the upper half of the dark surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular semi-circular missing segment on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe; dense network of vertical linear white scars across the central dorsal-ventral axis of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct reticulated or lattice-like white pigmentation pattern concentrated at the central junction where the lobes meet the peduncle.
